gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.004127 34.065208)',4326)::geography, 4000)
  AND p.tourism = 'hotel'
  AND elev.z >= 240;

WITH target_poi AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.004127 34.065208)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 4000) AS geom
  FROM target_poi
),
elevation_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326), true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    buffered_area
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(clipped_rast, true) AS stats
  FROM elevation_clip
),
min_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    (stats).min_val AS min_elevation
  FROM elevation_stats
)
SELECT 
  'Treetop Quest Gwinnett, Buford, GA' AS feature_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT min_elevation FROM min_elevation) >= 240 THEN 'Elevation meets or exceeds 240 m'
    ELSE 'Elevation below 240 m'
  END AS elevation_status;
